taxonomies.name: Unilateral Modification
patterns: modify these terms at any time
change fees at its sole discretion
taxonomies.reason: Permits one party to modify prices, SLAs, or covenants unilaterally without advance consent or right of refund.

taxonomies.name: Asymmetric Indemnification
patterns: customer shall indemnify provider for any regulatory
taxonomies.reason: Imposes one-sided defense and indemnity obligations on the customer while providing zero IP or breach defense from the vendor.

taxonomies.name: Forced Arbitration & Class Action Waiver
patterns: waives all rights to a jury trial
waive any right to participate in a class action
taxonomies.reason: Eliminates access to open judicial courts, jury trials, and class representation in disputes.

taxonomies.name: AI Model Training & Data Expropriation
patterns: train machine learning models on customer data
perpetual, irrevocable license to customer data
taxonomies.reason: Vendor appropriates customer proprietary code or confidential datasets to train commercial LLMs and generative systems.

taxonomies.name: Trapped Auto-Renewal
taxonomies.reason: Imposes restrictive cancellation barriers (such as narrow notice windows or physical mail requirements) to lock customers into recurring billing.

taxonomies.name: Extreme Liability Disclaimers
patterns: as is and as available with all faults
disclaims all liability for data loss
in no event shall vendor be liable for direct
taxonomies.reason: Guts remedies by capping maximum vendor damages to a nominal sum ($50) or disclaiming all essential warranties.

taxonomies.name: Overbroad Restrictive Covenants
patterns: competing business for a period of five
taxonomies.reason: Imposes unreasonable multi-year or global geographic work restrictions that may violate public policy.

taxonomies.name: Unilateral Immediate Termination
taxonomies.reason: Gives one party unrestricted power to terminate services instantly with no opportunity to cure or retrieve data.
